user_story: As a visitor I want a stable top navigation so I can reach home, contacts and about from every page.
expected_behavior: The nav remains visible at the top, the fIAq brand links to home, Inicio/Sobre are links, Contatos opens the department drawer, focus is visible and there is no horizontal overflow on mobile.
test_method: Browser: visit all routes at mobile and desktop widths; keyboard tab through nav.
errors_found: No horizontal overflow in route sweep.
fix_notes: No code change needed in this pass.

user_story: As a visitor I want to open contacts and choose a department without losing context.
expected_behavior: Clicking Contatos opens a right drawer, body scroll is locked, Escape/click outside closes it, focus is trapped, department links navigate to /contatos/:slug.
test_method: Browser: open drawer, test Escape, focus trap and department link.
errors_found: Close button had only title; transition-all remained on department links.
fix_notes: Added aria-label, overscroll containment and explicit transitions.

user_story: As a visitor I want to ask a question from the home page and land in the assistant with that question sent.
expected_behavior: Submitting a non-empty prompt navigates to /chatbot?q=..., the chat sends it once, the input remains readable on mobile, and the send button is easy to tap.
test_method: Browser: type in home search, submit, assert /chatbot and question bubble.
errors_found: Mobile placeholder was too long and clipped beside the send button.
fix_notes: Changed placeholder to shorter text with ellipsis, added name/autocomplete.

user_story: As a visitor I want to open the assistant directly from home.
expected_behavior: The assistant link opens /chatbot with empty state, suggestions and composer ready.
test_method: Browser: click assistant link and inspect empty state.
errors_found: Chat empty state had unlabeled textarea and image without explicit dimensions.
fix_notes: Added composer aria-label/name and image width/height.

user_story: As a visitor I want to browse FAQ categories by theme.
expected_behavior: Categories load from /api/faq, show title/count/icon, lay out responsively, and each card opens /faq/:slug.
test_method: Browser and API: /api/faq returns categories; click first category.
errors_found: No functional error; card transition used generic transition-all.
fix_notes: Changed category card transition to explicit border/shadow transition.

feature: Category page loading and not found
user_story: As a visitor I want a category page to either show the selected FAQ or a clear not-found state.
expected_behavior: Valid slug shows title/count/items; invalid slug shows Categoria nao encontrada and a link back home.
test_method: Browser: visit valid and invalid FAQ slugs.
errors_found: Valid and invalid routes rendered without overflow.
fix_notes: No code change needed for not-found path.

user_story: As a visitor I want to search questions inside a category.
expected_behavior: The search input filters by title/content, ignores accents/case, has a label, and shows an empty search state when nothing matches.
test_method: Browser: enter matching and non-matching terms.
errors_found: Placeholder used three dots and search field lacked name/autocomplete.
fix_notes: Added name, autocomplete off and typographic ellipsis.

user_story: As a visitor I want to expand a question and see the answer plus official source.
expected_behavior: Clicking a question toggles it, rendered markdown is readable, official source appears as a chip/link, and the CTA opens /chatbot.
test_method: Browser: expand/collapse item, click source and CTA.
errors_found: Long FAQ titles were clipped because Button base uses whitespace nowrap.
fix_notes: Overrode FAQ buttons with h-auto, whitespace-normal and break-word title span.

user_story: As a visitor I want department contact pages with address, map and contact cards.
expected_behavior: /contatos/:slug shows badge, description, address, map when available, contact cards and valid mail/phone/external links; invalid slug shows not-found state.
test_method: Browser: visit valid/invalid department, inspect cards and map.
errors_found: No overflow or broken state found in route sweep.
fix_notes: No code change in this pass.

user_story: As a visitor I want to understand what fIAq is, its stack, IA flow and team.
expected_behavior: /sobre shows brand, objective, technologies, IA explanation and team links without layout overflow.
test_method: Browser: visit /sobre at mobile/desktop and inspect links.
errors_found: No overflow found in route sweep.
fix_notes: No code change in this pass.

user_story: As a visitor I want a useful empty chat state with suggested questions.
expected_behavior: Empty chat shows Sarue, greeting, suggestions, and clicking a suggestion sends that text once.
test_method: Browser: /chatbot, inspect empty state and suggestions.
errors_found: Sarue image had no explicit dimensions.
fix_notes: Added width/height to empty-state image.

user_story: As a visitor I want to submit chat messages efficiently.
expected_behavior: Typing text enables the send button, Enter sends, Shift/Alt/Ctrl/Meta+Enter does not send, textarea grows up to max height, and disabled state prevents duplicate sends.
test_method: Browser: fill composer, Shift+Enter, then Enter submit.
errors_found: Textarea had no accessible label/name; placeholder used three dots.
fix_notes: Added aria-label, name, inputmode and typographic ellipsis. Browser retest confirmed Shift+Enter did not send and Enter sent.

user_story: As a mobile visitor I want the composer to stay usable when the on-screen keyboard is open.
expected_behavior: Composer remains sticky above safe area, header/actions do not crowd the viewport while focused, text is at least 16px, and no content is hidden behind the composer.
test_method: Browser mobile viewport: focus composer, type, scroll, inspect overlap.
errors_found: Message action buttons were hidden under the sticky composer after stream completion.
fix_notes: Increased bottom padding and changed scrollToBottom to scroll to document bottom so padding is respected.

user_story: As a visitor I want the assistant to show research activity and stream an answer.
expected_behavior: POST /api/chat returns SSE status/activity/sources/token/done, UI shows activity, final bubble is not empty, and loading stops.
test_method: API curl plus Browser: send real question and wait for action buttons.
errors_found: No LLM error after previous env boot fix; test detector initially missed uppercase source label.
fix_notes: No app change needed for source detection; browser retest saw sources and no error.

user_story: As a visitor I want verified sources below the answer instead of raw URLs in the text.
expected_behavior: Sources render as compact chips with title, host and external-link affordance; long titles truncate; invalid source URLs do not render broken links.
test_method: Browser: inspect answer with sources; code review invalid URL branch.
errors_found: Source chips visible and not covered after scroll fix.
fix_notes: No source component change needed in this pass.

user_story: As a visitor I want to copy an answer.
expected_behavior: Copy button copies clean assistant text, falls back when Clipboard API is unavailable, and shows copied/error status without moving layout.
test_method: Browser: click copy and assert copied status.
errors_found: Not executed in first pass beyond verifying button visibility.
fix_notes: Added aria-live to action status for copy/export feedback; browser retest saw Copiado status.

user_story: As a visitor I want to download the selected question/answer exchange.
expected_behavior: Export menu offers PDF, Excel, Markdown, JSON and TXT; each export includes the previous user question, selected answer and sources only.
test_method: Browser: export menu plus JSON download content assertion.
errors_found: Menu opened and options were present; first pass did not assert file content.
fix_notes: Added aria-live for export status; browser retest downloaded JSON and verified messages.

user_story: As a visitor I want to mark an answer as helpful.
expected_behavior: Helpful feedback updates the selected answer, persists to /api/chat/feedback, thanks the user, and sends web-sourced answers to curation.
test_method: Browser/API: click helpful after answer; inspect UI status and network result.
errors_found: Feedback menu visibility tested in first pass; helpful click/persistence not executed then.
fix_notes: Added aria-live to feedback/action status; browser retest saw Ajudou and Obrigado pelo feedback.

user_story: As a visitor I want to request a better answer when one is not useful.
expected_behavior: Unhelpful feedback marks the answer, persists feedback, then streams a complementary /api/chat/web response with web source mode.
test_method: Browser/API: click unhelpful after answer; wait for second assistant response.
errors_found: Negative feedback/web complement not executed in first pass.
fix_notes: No code change in this pass; browser retest marked unhelpful and received a second response without failure.

user_story: As a returning visitor I want the temporary chat to remain during the browser session.
expected_behavior: Stable non-empty messages are saved to sessionStorage, reload restores them, and clear removes them.
test_method: Browser: send messages, reload, clear, inspect restored state.
errors_found: Persistence reload not executed in first pass.
fix_notes: No code change in this pass; browser retest confirmed question remained after reload.

user_story: As a visitor I want to import a previously exported JSON conversation.
expected_behavior: Import accepts JSON conversation files, validates messages/sources, confirms replacement when needed, replaces conversation and reports invalid files clearly.
test_method: Browser: import valid and invalid JSON fixture.
errors_found: Static scan found hidden file input missing label/name; upload flow not executed in first pass.
fix_notes: Added file input name and aria-label; browser retest confirmed invalid error and valid import.

user_story: As a visitor I want to clear the current conversation safely.
expected_behavior: Clear is disabled when there is no meaningful content, asks for confirmation, clears messages/sessionStorage and shows temporary status.
test_method: Browser: clear empty and non-empty conversations.
errors_found: Clear flow not executed in first pass.
fix_notes: Added aria-live to conversation status; browser retest accepted confirmation and saw empty state.

user_story: As a visitor reading an older message I want to jump back to the latest response.
expected_behavior: When the user scrolls away from the bottom, a button appears above the composer, does not cover input, and scrolls smoothly to the bottom.
test_method: Browser: create long answer, scroll up, click jump button.
errors_found: Message action buttons were hidden under composer and dedicated jump flow was not executed in first pass.
fix_notes: Added aria-label and explicit transition; fixed bottom scroll alignment. Browser retest confirmed jump visible and bottom distance 0.

user_story: As an admin I want a clear setup message when Supabase auth is not configured.
expected_behavior: When public Supabase env vars are missing, /admin shows a clear configuration message instead of broken login UI.
test_method: Browser with current env; code review fallback branch.
errors_found: Local env lacks public Supabase config, so login form is intentionally hidden and setup message appears.
fix_notes: No functional change; guard behavior confirmed.

user_story: As an admin I want to sign in, reveal/hide password and sign out.
expected_behavior: Email/password fields have labels/names/autocomplete, eye button toggles visibility, submit shows busy state, logout clears session and admin UI.
test_method: Browser with mocked Supabase auth and mocked admin APIs because local VITE_SUPABASE_* is absent.
errors_found: Login form not reachable in original local env because VITE_SUPABASE_URL/VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are not configured.
fix_notes: Added labels, names, autocomplete and spellcheck hints; mocked browser retest confirmed reveal, login, authorized UI and logout.

user_story: As an invited admin I want to set a password from the invite callback.
expected_behavior: Invite session in URL hash shows password form, validates min length, eye toggles visibility, saves password and validates admin access.
test_method: Browser with mocked Supabase user update and mocked admin APIs.
errors_found: Invite hash flow needed an isolated browser context; first reused-SPA attempt stayed in prior admin state.
fix_notes: Added new-password name/autocomplete and label; isolated mocked retest confirmed password reveal and authorized UI after saving.

user_story: As an admin I want to view pending, approved and rejected candidate answers.
expected_behavior: After auth, tabs show totals, loading and empty states are clear, status filter fetches correct API query and list updates in real time.
test_method: Unauthenticated API guard plus mocked authorized browser UI.
errors_found: Unauthenticated /api/admin/candidates correctly returns 401; authorized UI could not use real Supabase locally.
fix_notes: Mocked browser retest confirmed Pendentes/Aprovadas/Rejeitadas tabs and candidate rendering.

user_story: As an admin I want to approve or reject a candidate answer with optional notes.
expected_behavior: Pending candidate cards show question, answer, sources, notes textarea, approve/reject actions and success/error notice; approved writes to RAG.
test_method: Browser with mocked authorized admin APIs.
errors_found: Review flow could not use real admin session/test candidate locally.
fix_notes: Added accessible aria-label/name/id to review notes textarea; mocked retest confirmed approve notice and PATCH call.

user_story: As an admin I want to invite another administrator by email.
expected_behavior: Invite form posts email to /api/admin/invites, clears the field on success, and shows clear errors without exposing secrets.
test_method: Browser with mocked authorized admin APIs.
errors_found: Invite flow could not use real admin session locally.
fix_notes: Added invite email label/name/autocomplete/spellcheck hints; mocked retest confirmed Convite enviado notice and POST call.

user_story: As an admin I want to know whether the curation queue is receiving live updates.
expected_behavior: Realtime badge shows connected/connecting/slow/error/closed, includes last sync time using Intl, and refreshes candidates after realtime changes.
test_method: Browser with mocked admin UI and fake Supabase endpoint.
errors_found: Realtime admin flow could not connect to a real Supabase realtime channel locally.
fix_notes: Mocked authorized UI showed Tempo real badge and handled realtime error state without breaking the page.

user_story: As the frontend I need /api/faq to provide categories and items for home and FAQ pages.
expected_behavior: GET /api/faq returns a category array from DB or fallback JSON and does not crash when DB is unavailable.
test_method: API curl and page render.
errors_found: No endpoint error found.
fix_notes: No code change in this pass.

user_story: As an operator I want to verify database connectivity quickly.
expected_behavior: GET /api/health/db returns ok/configured/latency when configured and a clear configured=false state otherwise.
test_method: API curl.
errors_found: Endpoint returned 200 ok/configured true in current env.
fix_notes: No code change in this pass.

user_story: As the app I want an API for frequent questions metrics.
expected_behavior: GET /api/perguntas/em-alta returns aggregated anonymous questions for future UI use without exposing personal data.
test_method: API curl/code review.
errors_found: Endpoint returned 200 with aggregate items.
fix_notes: No code change in this pass.

user_story: As a developer I want the app to run on SvelteKit/Vite with shadcn-svelte components.
expected_behavior: No legacy framework/server config/imports remain, SvelteKit/Vite build works, shadcn-svelte components live in src/lib/components/ui, and core buttons/inputs/textareas use shadcn wrappers.
test_method: rg scans plus lint/typecheck/build.
errors_found: No legacy framework/server imports in app code; LICENSE now names fIAq contributors.
fix_notes: Updated shadcn Button base to remove transition-all while preserving focus styles.
evidence: pnpm lint; pnpm typecheck; NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 pnpm build

user_story: As any user I want consistent buttons, fonts, focus states, touch targets and readable copy across the app.
expected_behavior: Primary/secondary/destructive actions are visually consistent, font scale is readable, icon-only controls have aria-label/title, motion respects preferences, and layouts avoid card nesting/overflow.
test_method: Static guidelines scan plus browser screenshots at mobile and desktop widths.
errors_found: Initial scan found transition-all, three-dot placeholders, unlabeled composer, missing image dimensions, FAQ clipping and chat action overlap.
fix_notes: Fixed and retested public/chat UI issues plus copy/export/feedback/import/clear/jump. Admin UX was retested with mocked auth/API because real local Supabase env is absent.

user_story: As an operator I want the public production URL to match the tested worktree before this UI QA is considered fully done.
expected_behavior: Production /admin and public routes should reflect the current Vite/shadcn UI fixes after an approved deploy, including admin field labels/names and current accessibility fixes.
test_method: Browser: production logged-out admin smoke test.
errors_found: Production APIs are healthy, but production /admin still reflects an older deployment: email/password inputs lack the local fixes for id/name/labels. No deploy was performed because pushing/deploying main requires explicit approval.
fix_notes: Local code already fixes the issue; deploy production after approval, then rerun production smoke and authenticated admin test with safe credentials.

user_story: As a visitor I want the chat to explain what happened when verified sources are found but the answer generator fails.
expected_behavior: When /api/chat sends an LLM_UNAVAILABLE SSE event after sources, the assistant keeps the verified sources visible and shows a specific retry-oriented message instead of a generic processing error.
test_method: Browser: Playwright route mocked /api/chat SSE with sources plus LLM_UNAVAILABLE on mobile viewport.
errors_found: The previous UI displayed a generic processing error that made it look like the whole request failed even though sources were already available.
fix_notes: Replaced the generic fallback with a specific message for unavailable generation and a connection-specific send failure message.

user_story: As an operator I want the SvelteKit production build to serve public routes and API routes locally before deploy.
expected_behavior: The built app served by Vite preview should render core routes and answer health/FAQ API requests without visual accessibility regressions or route errors.
test_method: Production preview server plus Playwright sweep across mobile and desktop for /, /chatbot, /sobre, /faq/matricula, /faq/estrutura-curricular, /contatos/cic and /admin.
errors_found: No preview-only error found. API health/db returned ok/configured true and /api/faq returned 200 application/json.
fix_notes: No code change required after the preview sweep.

user_story: As an operator I want admin-only endpoints to reject unauthenticated requests before exposing admin data or actions.
expected_behavior: GET /api/admin/me, GET /api/admin/candidates, PATCH /api/admin/candidates/:id and POST /api/admin/invites must return 401 AUTH_REQUIRED without a valid bearer token.
test_method: API curl without Authorization header on local dev server.
errors_found: /api/admin/me was not tracked as an explicit user story even though it gates the admin UI.
fix_notes: Added explicit coverage for unauthenticated admin API behavior; all checked endpoints returned 401 AUTH_REQUIRED.

user_story: As a visitor or search/social crawler I want pages to publish accurate titles and descriptions.
expected_behavior: Home/chatbot should keep the default fIAq metadata, and Sobre, FAQ category and contact pages should update document title, description, Open Graph title/description and Twitter card.
test_method: Playwright read document title and meta tags for /, /chatbot, /sobre, /faq/matricula and /contatos/cic.
errors_found: SEO metadata existed in code but was not independently tracked in the canonical feature spreadsheet.
fix_notes: Recorded metadata behavior and verified dynamic route metadata with the real CIC contact slug.

user_story: As a visitor I want assistant responses to keep useful formatting without exposing raw links, numeric citation clutter or unsafe HTML.
expected_behavior: Markdown from the assistant should render bold/lists/paragraphs, strip inline/raw links and numeric citation sections from the visible answer, sanitize script HTML, and keep verified sources in source chips.
test_method: Playwright mocked /api/chat SSE with markdown, inline link, numeric citation section and script HTML.
errors_found: Safe Markdown rendering was partially covered by source-chip tests but not documented as its own behavior.
fix_notes: Added explicit test showing the unsafe script is not executed/rendered, citation markers are removed, raw link text is absent, and the source chip stays visible.

user_story: As an operator I want Vercel to route all /api/* requests through SvelteKit server routes.
expected_behavior: SvelteKit should own /api/* through src/routes/api/**/+server.ts, use adapter-vercel, and keep chat streaming/admin APIs compatible with production functions.
test_method: SvelteKit build plus TypeScript server route check.
errors_found: The previous catch-all adapter was removed during the SvelteKit port.
fix_notes: Verified server routes compile and Vercel config uses framework sveltekit.

user_story: As a developer I want root-level pnpm commands to operate the SvelteKit app in fiaq-app without remembering the subdirectory.
expected_behavior: Root package scripts should forward dev/build/preview/lint/typecheck and knowledge commands into fiaq-app, preserving the repository root as the normal operator entry point.
test_method: Package manifest review plus repeated successful root pnpm lint/typecheck/build/build:faq commands.
errors_found: Root command forwarding is documented as part of the SvelteKit migration.
fix_notes: Validated root command mapping and re-ran root lint/typecheck/build/build:faq successfully.

user_story: As a maintainer I want Markdown FAQ sources to regenerate stable JSON files for the FAQ and RAG pipeline.
expected_behavior: pnpm build:faq should parse data/sources/faq-cic-unb/secoes into data/faq/faq-*.json, preserve unique IDs and produce reproducible output without unrelated diffs.
test_method: Executed pnpm build:faq and checked git diff for generated FAQ/source files.
errors_found: FAQ generation was used by the app but not explicitly tracked as a user story.
fix_notes: build:faq generated 85 entries in 7 files and git diff showed no generated FAQ/source changes.

feature: Knowledge maintenance scripts and provider smoke guards
user_story: As a maintainer I want RAG indexing, crawling, seeding and provider smoke scripts to be syntactically valid and stop safely when required credentials are absent.
expected_behavior: Operational scripts should parse successfully; DB-writing seeds should refuse to run without DATABASE_URL; OpenRouter smoke should refuse to run without OPENROUTER_API_KEY; network/DB-writing full runs require explicit operator credentials.
test_method: node --check for .mjs scripts, python py_compile for browser-use script, guarded executions with blank DATABASE_URL/OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
errors_found: Knowledge maintenance scripts were not explicitly represented in the feature spreadsheet; full crawl/seed/provider runs can have external side effects.
fix_notes: Added syntax and missing-env guard tests while intentionally avoiding real external crawls, production database writes and provider quota usage.

user_story: As a maintainer I want the post-migration app to preserve public, chat, FAQ, contact and admin behavior while running on SvelteKit/TanStack/shadcn-svelte.
expected_behavior: Preview routes render in mobile and desktop without 500s or horizontal overflow; Saruê assets load; /api/health/db, /api/faq, /api/perguntas/em-alta and admin guards work; real /api/chat SSE emits sources, tokens and done; mocked browser chat, FAQ accordion, brand link and contacts drawer flows pass.
code_reference: fiaq-app/src/routes/**; fiaq-app/src/lib/components/**; fiaq-app/src/lib/stores/fiaq-chat.ts; fiaq-app/server/utils/llmProvider.ts; fiaq-app/svelte.config.js; fiaq-app/vercel.json
test_method: pnpm lint; pnpm typecheck; NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 pnpm build; Vite preview; curl endpoints; Playwright mobile/desktop sweep and mocked SSE UI flows.
errors_found: Initial SvelteKit preview exposed SSR window access on /chatbot, public assets were not served from public/, OpenRouter empty heartbeat could hang before fallback, and the contacts drawer did not close on Escape without focus.
fix_notes: Guarded browser-only cleanup in chat components, configured SvelteKit assets to use public/, made OpenRouter stream timeout reset only on useful content, and registered a document Escape handler/focus for the drawer.
